item.title: 5 New AI Tools to Explore — Week of August 24, 2026
item.description: An editorially reviewed look at five newly discovered AI tools across coding, productivity, video, and image creation, with verified capabilities, pricing models, and links to detailed listings.

item.title: Videm
item.description: Videm is a browser-based text-to-image generator for visual concepts, product scenes, social creative, and editorial images. Guests can generate up to three images per day without signing in, save the results, and use outputs without a platform watermark. Additional models become available after login.

item.title: DrawDB Pro
item.description: DrawDB is a visual database-schema and entity-relationship diagram tool for developers. Its AI schema assistant can draft tables, relationships, and types from a description. The free, open-source editor works without an account and stores diagrams locally, while Pro adds cloud storage, team permissions, versioning, and real-time collaboration.

item.title: APIMatic Context
item.description: APIMatic Context is a registry of installable Context Plugins for AI coding agents. Each plugin combines guidance with typed, language-specific SDK reference code so an agent can handle details such as authentication, retries, rate limits, migrations, and provider changes. The public catalog covers APIs across payments, communications, data, media, and developer tooling.

item.title: AIE Talks
item.description: AIE Talks is a searchable written index of more than 1,100 presentations from AI Engineer conferences. It helps visitors find relevant moments through semantic search, concise summaries, timestamps, quotations, speakers, topics, and curated packs. Talk and pack pages are also available as plain Markdown, and the collection is updated as new presentations appear.

item.title: Jern Cloud
item.description: Jern Cloud runs coding-agent tasks on isolated machines under a policy pinned for the entire session. It applies hard token and runtime limits, keeps model and repository credentials outside the agent process, records encrypted evidence, and returns work as a pull request for human review. The service includes a 30-day trial, then costs $19 per month per workspace; model usage is billed through the user’s own provider key.

item.title: StillMade
item.description: StillMade is an AI-assisted video workspace built around guided project creation. Its current experience lets creators start image-panel, whiteboard-motion, or blank projects and build a reusable library of characters, locations, and styles to keep visual elements consistent across scenes. The product offers limited free usage and supports bringing your own model API keys.

item.title: OpenHelper AI Chatbot
item.description: OpenHelper is a general-purpose, open-source browser chatbot rather than a dedicated customer-support platform. Its published interface emphasizes unlimited use, local chat history, responsive device support, dynamic themes, and an ad- and tracking-free experience. Novera keeps it as a directory-only listing because its broader AI capabilities could not be independently verified in enough detail for this roundup.

item.title: Dehurdle

item.title: Supercov
item.description: Supercov is a free, MIT-licensed coverage tool designed to give coding agents actionable testing gaps. It wraps an existing test command, reports uncovered paths, and lets the agent add focused tests and repeat the loop while useful gaps remain. It supports line, branch, and MC/DC coverage across common JavaScript, TypeScript, Rust, and Python test suites.
